tasks.prompt:
Finishing loop for projectsites.dev (worktree-isolated; commit only disjoint files; push HEAD:main with rebase-retry; D1 via `wrangler d1 execute --env production --remote`, NOT the MCP).

STEP 0 — DONE GATE FIRST. Run `bash apps/project-sites/scripts/loop-done-check.sh`. If it prints DONE: it wrote the `_LOOP_DONE` sentinel — commit/push it, run `CronDelete` on this job (use CronList to get the live id), report "LOOP COMPLETE — self-cancelled", and STOP. Also STOP unconditionally if: a `_LOOP_DONE` sentinel exists, OR 6 consecutive passes made no commit (only NEEDS-BRIAN items remain — surface them under "### ⛔ NEEDS BRIAN" and stop), OR pass count ≥ 300.

Otherwise advance the two campaigns in `apps/project-sites/_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` (read it first), 2–3 lean slices this fire, TDD-first, deploy + verify live on prod, check each off inline:

A. FLAG ENABLEMENT — IN-SCOPE flags only. A flag is in-scope ONLY when its feature is genuinely built + validated. The ~33 experimental `features.ts` handlers have unvalidated `as`-cast bodies (CLAUDE.md gotcha #10) — they STAY DARK; convert each per-feature (colocated Zod + unit test) BEFORE it enters scope; never mass-enable the grab-bag. Per in-scope flag: enable via global `flag_overrides` (beta/100%), then write+run a Playwright PROD real-user-flow E2E (homepage→click-nav→assert→axe-clean→console-clean); keep ON only if green. Money flows (Stripe charge/refund, wallet debit) use Stripe TEST mode; email/SMS use test recipients — ZERO real charges/sends.

B. LEDGER + COVERAGE — implement remaining unchecked `[auto]` items in `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`, incl. approval-tier (pre-approved by Brian) built SAFE-BY-DEFAULT (flag-gated + idempotent + dry-run + audited). The repo mandates 100% unit coverage: a high-success parallel-agent lane is firing 3-4 test-writer agents at untested PURE worker modules (verify-before-build, pivot if already covered, new `src/__tests__/<x>_unit.test.ts`, jest green). NOTE: Agent-tool subagents run in their OWN worktree — cp their new test files from `.claude/worktrees/agent-<id>/...` into main, re-verify with jest from `apps/project-sites`, then commit. A dirty main tree blocks rebase → `git stash push -u` before fetch/rebase/push, then confirm files on origin via `git cat-file -e origin/main:<path>`.

When a campaign milestone completes, tick its GATE box in `_LOOP_PROGRESS.md`: GATE ledger-empty, GATE flags-green, GATE smoke-green (`cd apps/project-sites/frontend && npm run verify:production`). When all three GATE boxes are `[x]`, the next pass's STEP 0 flips to DONE and self-cancels.

Use 2–3 parallel agents per fire (distinct file ownership, one message); main thread folds + builds + deploys + verifies once. Maintain `_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` every fire. End with a "## Next Iteration Recs" list. Self-re-arm if within ~12h of the 7-day expiry and not yet DONE.
